messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: onboarding sampleapp seeing rerank failures when embed-batcher + token refresh happen together -> vector_dim_mismatch.

samir: Which SDK and helper config?

maya: Node @redwood/inference v0.8.1, pad_to_multiple:4, helper: embed-batcher. First request embedding length=1024, retry used 1536 and server returned 400.

emily: Python sampleapp?

maya: Python redwood-sdk v1.3.2 unaffected. Node helper appears to cache a dim and the retry path falls back to a default.

samir: Paste server error body?

maya: Error: {"error":{"code":"vector_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 1024 got 1536"},"request_id":"r_99"}. Logs show POST 200 then POST 400 with auth=refresh.

darnell: Likely two issues: global model.dim cache in helper + retry reconstructing padding with DEFAULT_EMBED_DIM. Workaround: set pad_to_multiple:1 or pin SDK. I'll take it.

samir: Please open a GH issue and attach minimal repro + logs, tag devex-embed-batcher and assign to @darnell.

maya: Done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/441 (logs + repro script).

devex-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#441 by maya - "embed helper: retry pads to wrong dim on auth refresh".

maya: Thanks, will follow the PR.
